facts_for_explanation.what_it_is: From VAT periods starting on or after 1 January 2023, each VAT Return sent late (including nil and repayment returns) gets one penalty point. When the points reach the threshold, HMRC charges a £200 penalty, and another £200 for each further late return while at the threshold.
facts_for_explanation.removing_points: At the threshold, points are removed only when both are met: (A) a period of compliance – all returns on time for 24 months (annual), 12 months (quarterly) or 6 months (monthly); and (B) all outstanding returns for the previous 24 months sent. Below the threshold, each point expires on its own after about 24 months.
facts_for_explanation.how_to_challenge: Ask HMRC for a review through the VAT online account, or write to: Solicitor's Office and Legal Services, HMRC, BX9 1ZT. A penalty can be cancelled if there was a reasonable excuse. Usually within 30 days of the penalty decision.
facts_for_explanation.pay: Even while appealing, keep sending returns on time to stop more points.

appeal_output.post_to: Solicitor's Office and Legal Services, HMRC, BX9 1ZT
appeal_output.online_alternative: Ask for a review in the business's VAT online account
